items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority (Krankenkasse, social law). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to the delivery-fiction day itself). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later on the same numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in NW (not a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday), so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The letter rejects the Haushaltshilfe request because the children are 14 and 16 (over the age-12 limit under § 38 SGB V) and Herr Musterquell himself is not ill; this is the stated legal reason, not a sign of error, but worth double-checking against the actual facts of the case.

Deemed-delivery assumes the letter was sent by ordinary post on its printed date (19.11.2026); if it was actually posted later or served differently (e.g. a yellow envelope), the one-month Widerspruch deadline would shift accordingly.
